title: The no low-energy sampleable states conjecture
formal: Is there a family of local Hamiltonians and a constant energy-density threshold above the ground energy such that no family of states below that threshold is efficiently classically sampleable in the sense of Gharibian and Le Gall?
context:
Use the primary paper's sample-access model; sampling measurement outcomes alone must not silently replace all of its conditions. NLTS has been proved and does not by itself settle NLESS.

This question was found through Wikipedia and compared individually with the existing candidate and archived records. The linked literature provides definitions and background; this import is not a completed research-card review.
why: Would rule out a much broader classical description of low-energy quantum states than shallow quantum circuits.
